title: 云计算进入AI代理与主权边缘新纪元：AWS、微软、Google Cloud竞相强化AI治理与基础设施
core_insight: 云厂商正加速AI代理基础设施成熟化并向边缘主权AI演进，同时AI安全治理和垂直行业SaaS专业化成为关键竞争维度，标志云计算进入分布式智能与深度行业应用新阶段

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出S3 Files将对象存储转为高性能文件系统，Google Cloud QueryData提升AI代理数据访问准确性，Cloudflare重新设计AI时代缓存架构应对超100亿次/周AI请求 AWS Aurora PostgreSQL支持秒级数据库创建，Cloudflare网络容量突破500Tbps，微软Kubernetes操作成熟度在KubeCon展示提升 Launching S3 Files, making S3 buckets accessible as file systems QueryData helps agents turn natural language into queries for AlloyDB, Cloud SQL and Spanner 500 Tbps of capacity: 16 years of scaling our global network Why we're rethinking cache for the AI era Announcing Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL serverless database creation in seconds What’s new with Microsoft in open-source and Kubernetes at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe 2026 Introducing Programmable Flow Protection: custom DDoS mitigation logic for Magic Transit customers How we use Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) to turn Workflows code into visual diagrams Announcing managed daemon support for Amazon ECS Managed Instances Raising the security baseline: Essential AI and cloud security now on by default
dimension_texts.infrastructure: 微软与Armada合作推出Azure Local on Galleon模块化数据中心实现边缘主权AI部署，微软主权云平台在Forrester Wave评估中获领导者地位，AWS推出可持续性控制台整合Scope 1-3碳排放报告 Cloudflare公布2029年全面后量子安全路线图，NVIDIA投资SiFive达到36.5亿美元估值显示AI芯片生态持续活跃 Building sovereign AI at the edge: Microsoft and Armada collaborate to deliver Azure Local on Galleon modular datacenters Microsoft named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™ for Sovereign Cloud Platforms Announcing the AWS Sustainability console: Programmatic access, configurable CSV reports, and Scope 1–3 reporting in one place Cloudflare targets 2029 for full post-quantum security Nvidia-backed SiFive hits $3.65 billion valuation for open AI chips
